Subject: POC kickoff — hands-on deep dives: scheduling

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. We’re ready to lock in the POC kickoff and want to run three hands-on deep‑dive sessions (prompt review, routing tests, and a short load rehearsal) across our Product, Platform, and Ops teams. We have folks in US (PST/PDT), EU (CEST) and APAC (SGT) — ideally we’d run the working blocks so each region can join one session in reasonable local hours.

Rough ask: three 90-minute blocks across two calendar days; rotating start times so no single region is stuck at midnight. Our initial availability (all times in local):
- US team: earliest 09:00 PDT, latest 16:00 PDT
- EU team: earliest 09:00 CEST, latest 17:00 CEST
- APAC team: earliest 10:00 SGT, latest 19:00 SGT

Can Redwood propose a set of staggered slots that we can accept or nudge (we prefer blocks to be contiguous so we can do prompt walkthroughs then run a routing micro-benchmark)? We’ll need a calendar invite and a runbook (checklist) for engineers; we can share logs/keys in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Senior Engineering Manager — Integrations
Globex Labs

Folks — forwarding Alex’s note. High-level ask: three 90m hands-on blocks, rotate start times to spread local burden. Key constraints for us:
- We need one engineer per session + a runbook owner (prefer Karthik)
- Routing micro-bench: 30m design/30m run/30m review — keep contiguous
- Prefer to avoid >22:00 local for any of their engineers

My proposed pattern (all times in UTC for clarity):
- Day 1: 15:00–16:30 UTC (works for US morning / EU afternoon / APAC evening) — prompt review + routing design
- Day 1: 18:00–19:30 UTC — routing micro-bench + quick load run (short)
- Day 2: 07:00–08:30 UTC — APAC-friendly block for final review and wrap

This staggers so each region has one session in reasonable local hours. If that’s too early for APAC in the Day 2 block, we can flip Day1/Day2. I attached a quick ics outline and a draft runbook for the micro-bench (see attachments). Can you own runbook finalization, Karthik? Jonas, can you verify availability for load-infrastructure at those windows?

Alex — will those rough UTC blocks map to your teams’ preferred local times? If OK I’ll send calendar invites (we’ll include a short pre-read and a link to a shared Slack channel).

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
